title: STOCKFLOW-123: contradictory acceptance pair test_large_gap_is_covered vs test_regression_issue_588
body:
STOCKFLOW-123 (replenishment_suggestions) has two acceptance tests on IDENTICAL input that assert opposite outputs.

Input: make_item('BAG-987654-9', 0, daily_demand=[100,100], lead_times=[10], annual_demand=400, order_cost_cents=100, holding_cost_cents=100, pack_size=10). reorder_point=1000, EOQ=30.

- test_large_gap_is_covered expects qty 1010 (on_hand=0) and 40 (on_hand=970) — i.e. 'cover the gap up to the reorder point'.
- test_regression_issue_588 expects qty 30 (on_hand=0) — i.e. pure EOQ.

The unit test (tests/test_replenishment_suggestions.py::test_example) and the stub docstring example both use pure EOQ: replenishment_suggestions([item with on_hand=50]) == [('ABC-123456-1', 190)] where EOQ=190 and gap=0. A single function cannot return both 30 and 1010 for the same input.

My implementation follows the spec (pure EOQ, round_to_pack), so unit + test_regression_issue_588 + test_trigger + test_nothing_to_order all pass; only test_large_gap_is_covered is red. Please confirm which behavior is intended and correct/remove the stale check so the ticket can go green.
